question: Does RPCI scenario-specific suitability/stability improve M3 calibrated top-3 probability beyond non-scenario history coverage?
universe: JRA flat, field>=12, 3-win or higher; M3 validation universe

protocol.rpci_scenario_model: multinomial logistic; trained 2018-2022; temperature calibration 2023 only
protocol.horse_scenario_fit: last 10 strictly prior starts; Gaussian RPCI similarity at anchors 42.5/47.5/52.5/57.5, bandwidth 3.0; finish-percentile shrinkage k=3
protocol.race_coherence: probabilities projected within race to sum exactly 3

features_tested.scenario_adv: scenario-probability-weighted suitability minus overall historical suitability
features_tested.scenario_stability_sd: scenario-probability-weighted SD of suitability across four RPCI bands

decision.reason: RPCI scenario-specific advantage/stability did not improve over history-coverage-only calibration in 2024 CV, and incremental OOS deltas versus history-only were essentially zero in 2025 and 2026 with CIs crossing zero.
decision.ui: Keep RPCI scenario support/stability as structural/display information; do not alter M3 structural top-3 probability with it.

caveats: The RPCI mixture model used for this test is a conservative pre-race model trained only through 2022 and calibrated on 2023; it is separate from the richer production RPCI v2.
Because the scenario-specific incremental effect was null even against this clean pre-race setup, no probability correction is deployed.
